text:
Maria H: Quick q — thinking about enabling short-lived, earmarked log views for analysts when they request SIEM exports. Proposing a default 7-day TTL for ephemeral snapshots with JIT KMS unwrap. Thoughts?

Devin: +1 for 7 days as a sensible default. For high-sev incidents allow a longer window (30d) with approval. Audit everything.

Ryan: For forensics we often need 30–90 days depending on scope. Can the window be configurable per-request and tied to the approval workflow? :thinking: 

audit-bot: ACTION_LOG: export_request created by Maria H for timeframe 2026-03-10..2026-03-13 id=exp_01E23 policy=ephemeral TTL=7d

Sophie: From a compliance/legal perspective, anything <90d needs documented business justification in the ticket. Need to surface that in the request UI/flow.

Devin: Draft proposal idea: tiered retention flow — Ephemeral (7d): auto-approved for SOC role siem_export_ephemeral, JIT KMS unwrap via proxy, masked PII by default. Incident (30d): requires on-call sec approval + persistent audit tag. Forensic (90d): requires ticket + manager + legal notification. KMS pattern: proxy unwrap that emits no plaintext to disk; ephemeral KEK rotated per-export.

Maria H: Example request payload we can wire to automation: 
```
export_request {
  requester: "maria.h@redwood.com"
  purpose: "customer-impact triage"
  sensitivity: "high"
  retention_days: 7
  approver: "oncall_sec"
  fields_mask: ["email","ip","user_agent"]
  kms_unwrap: "jit-proxy"
}
```

Ryan: Also add required field audit_tag: incident_id when retention >7d so we can correlate. And cap retention by tenant policy; don't let exports bypass tenant-level minima.

Sophie: Please add a checkbox in the flow: "Legal notified" if retention >30d — we need an auditable flag. Also log the legal contact and timestamp.

Devin: I'll sketch the RBAC changes in a PR: create role siem_export_ephemeral with constrained scope (timebox 7d), logging required; role siem_export_incident for 30d with approval gate; and siem_export_forensics for 90d with legal signoff. Will include KMS proxy integration details and sample playbook.

Maria H: Can you include UI mock link and acceptance criteria? https://figma.com/file/xyz

Devin: Yup — will add mocks + e2e acceptance: audit log entry for every unwrap, TTL enforcement job, and export deletion job + ticket field validation. Will ping for review tomorrow 11am PT.

Maria H: Perfect — thanks. :thumbsup:
